## EA Media Tools 2.6.8 - jaguar

### Windows toggle rendering fix

- Replace the custom Video, Filters, and audio switches with button-backed ARIA switches that never create or change native checkbox state.
- Temporal AQ and the other advanced encoder switches now update their settings and command preview without entering the Chromium checkbox paint path that could blank the frameless Windows window.
- Remove the v2.6.7 full-window repaint request, which did not recover the affected Windows surface and could retrigger the same rendering path.
- Preserve mouse and keyboard operation, disabled states, visual switch state, and FFmpeg hardware acceleration.

[Review changes since v2.6.7](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.7...v2.6.8).
